name: local-cache
description: cache dependencies and build outputs to improve workflow execution time on self hosted machine

scripts.package: ncc build lib/restore/index.js --source-map --license licenses.txt --out dist/restore/ && ncc build lib/save/index.js --source-map --license licenses.txt --out dist/save/
scripts.all: npm run build && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run package
